units.unit: Needs to work on a rent control / subdivided units essay
Wants sources pulled up on the SDU situation in Hong Kong with basic numbers
Framing is how many households and what they pay versus normal flats
Needs a source with headline numbers so as not to just assert them
Key question is whether the ordinance caps the initial rent or just increases
Has enough from D1 and D2
The second-generation vs first-generation distinction is the whole ballgame
Wants supply-elasticity material and Berlin numbers next
Wants to pin down the 3-5% figure before committing to it
